lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Pit Boss!

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Someone...

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: told me they had a crush on me.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: This is the first this has ever happened. It was so awkward...
Who was it?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: One of my fans.
Sorry, but I won't allow it. You're my girl.
Why don't you just turn him down?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I'm yours?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Haha!

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: You're pretty funny.
If I were you, I'd just turn them down.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Of course I rejected him.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: For one thing, dating fans is a big no-no.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: And besides that, this guy already tried the same thing with Noir before.
He did?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Noir turned him down, too.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Once that happened, he turned around and tried the same trick with me.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: A few days ago, he started waiting for us backstage until our shows were over.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: He sent me gifts, flowers, letters, and so on.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: While I appreciate it,

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: it also feels a bit suffocating, so I turned him down.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I told him that him cheering from the sidelines was more than enough.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: But the other day, he ended up storming the stage!

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Once he was there, he said he had feelings for me.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I can't even begin to tell you how embarrassing it was for me.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: He said he wouldn't get off the stage until I agreed to be with him.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: So I told him that I already had a boyfriend.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Once he heard that, he slunk off with his tail between his legs.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Now he says he doesn't believe me,

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: and he's insisting that I give him proof that I have a boyfriend.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Otherwise, he'll think I'm making the whole thing up.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: So the question is, how do I get a boyfriend?
I can pretend to be your boyfriend.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: You will?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Are you sure it's okay?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Coin Rush's customers can be intimidating.
I want to protect you. That's all that matters.
I assure you that I can be far more intimidating than them if I want to.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Ha!

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I'm so relieved.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I'll try and take care of it myself first.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: If it doesn't work, I'll come to you.
I'll be around if you need me.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I appreciate all the advice.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I've never encountered anything like this before, so I wasn't sure who to text.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Hopefully this'll solve the problem.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Thanks for the reassurance.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I'll try and let him down easy.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Thanks, Pit Boss!
